name: vibecode-like-a-dev
description: Turn a one-line idea or an existing repository into an enforceable software factory spec that any coding agent can execute.

scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run index -- --check && npm test && npm run verify && node specs/spec-check.mjs --repo . --strict && node specs/enforcement/gates.mjs --repo . --strict && npm run eval && npm run stress
scripts.dogfood: node factory/cli.mjs compile profile.json -o specs --force && node specs/spec-check.mjs --repo . --strict
scripts.eval: node scripts/eval-library.mjs && node scripts/eval-specificity.mjs && node scripts/eval-routing.mjs && node scripts/eval-outcome.mjs
